patch_description:
The current program over-simplified by sharing too many parameters (only 6 distinct), leading to poor worst_group_margin (0.21) and validation accuracy (0.79). Prior program 2 achieved 0.59 score with 10 distinct parameters and better worst_group_margin (0.31).

The key improvements:
1. Differentiate RZ gates using parity (rz_even/rz_odd) to match the RY parity encoding structure
2. Split the two-qubit interaction parameters by gate type (xx_param, yy_param, zz_param separate) rather than sharing across different gate types
3. Insert a lightweight parity-based mid-circuit RY layer before final RZ to boost expressivity while keeping parameter count modest

This restores expressivity for better robust separation on hard samples without excess parameter bloat, targeting ~9-10 distinct parameters and score ~0.58-0.60.
